title: Synergy of strength–ductility in HfMoTaTiZr refractory high entropy alloy through Cr addition

recollection.structure: high entropy alloy with improved mechanical properties
recollection.results: enhanced strength and ductility compared to the base alloy

score.note: The recollection identifies Cr addition and the broad strength–ductility improvement, but these are already conveyed by the title. It omits the 4.2 at.% Cr level, reticulated Cr₂(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase in the BCC matrix, the specific hardening/crack-hindrance mechanisms, and all quantitative values.
